findings.summary: Genesyz is a Next.js App Router application with a shared root layout.
The root layout installs UploadThing SSR, nuqs, React Query, theme, analytics, and toast providers.
The proxy combines Arcjet shield/bot detection with cookie-based protected-route and auth-route redirects.
The application persists its domain state through a Prisma-backed database client used by route handlers and services.
Idea creation authenticates, rate-limits and checks entitlement, accepts multimodal form data, extracts URLs, resolves location, and starts research.
Research runs Interpreter, four parallel specialist agents, then Synthesis, persisting packets/scores and marking the idea researched.
Weekly update creation validates input, checks startup capability, prevents duplicate weeks, persists goals and metrics, and audits the action.
The Inngest route registers research, email, reports, reminders, announcements, opportunity discovery, notifications, and cleanup functions with a 300-second max duration.
The repository-owned email test is the only test file found in the indexed source scope.
The current deterministic scan contains app/api route handler files; endpoint semantics and method counts remain route-specific.
